headline: Suspicion concentrated at jaw boundary — consistent with face-swap blending

signals.name: Deepfake classifier (cf + face probe)
signals.reason: Face-crop probe scores 0.88 (face-swap pattern); full-image detector scores 0.42.

signals.name: Error level analysis
signals.reason: Face region re-compresses 2.1x more strongly than the background.

signals.name: Frequency spectrum
signals.reason: High-frequency energy 12% above the real-photo baseline; no periodic GAN peaks.

signals.name: Noise residual
signals.reason: Face noise level differs from the background ring by 58%.

explanation: The strongest indicators sit along the jaw boundary, where the face-crop probe and the noise residual both show a mismatch between the face and its surroundings. This pattern is consistent with face-swap blending. Frequency and metadata signals are weak. These are probabilistic indicators; a human reviewer makes the final decision.
limitations: Trained/evaluated on DeepFakeFace; real and fake images come from different sources, so part of the signal may be source/compression domain.
Image was re-encoded (no camera EXIF), which can raise ELA and noise scores on genuine photos.
Face-swap detection is the weakest subset (probe AUC 0.87); inpainted or generated faces are caught more reliably.
disclaimer: Probabilistic forensic indicators only. Not proof of identity, authenticity or wrongdoing. Final decision rests with a human reviewer.
